Patchset 1 of change 2618 regressed one test on ubuntu-latest py3.12 (run 33860746582,
job 100997303992):

  FAILED tests/unit/test_repo_isolation_guard.py::test_git_probe_timeout_ignores_a_test_monkeypatch_of_time_sleep
    - Failed: DID NOT RAISE TimeoutExpired
  1 failed, 19188 passed, 77 skipped in 627.36s

This WAS mine, and the leading hypothesis (my change caused it) was correct. Root cause,
proven not assumed:

The probe SIGKILLs a stalled shim, and patchset 1 made it RE-SAMPLE afterwards. So for the
first time a later shim invocation READS a counter file that an earlier invocation was
killed while writing. `Path.write_text` truncates before it writes, so a kill in that
window leaves the counter EMPTY; the next shim dies on `int("")`; `check=True` turns that
into a CalledProcessError; and head()/porcelain() CATCH SubprocessError and return None.
head() returning None means 'not a git repo' -- for a repo that plainly is one -- so
pytest.raises(TimeoutExpired) sees no exception. That is the exact CI signature.

Proof, deterministic (the window modelled explicitly rather than waited for):
  truncating  -> head() returned None  == 'DID NOT RAISE TimeoutExpired'  [BUG]
  atomic      -> TimeoutExpired raised  [CORRECT]

Note this is a defect in the guard's TEST SHIM, not in the shipped probe: the shipped
probe's own state is the git repo, which it only reads.

Fix (patchset 2): the shim writes its counter ATOMICALLY (temp file + os.replace), so the
authoritative file is never truncated and no kill can leave it empty. That test's probe
timeout also moves 0.05s -> 0.5s so three attempts no longer race the shim's own Python
interpreter startup. The counter read stays STRICT -- tolerating a corrupt counter would
mask exactly this class of bug rather than remove it.

Checked, as asked: the only callers of _blocking_git are the two persistent tests I
re-pointed, my new transient test, and the fakes in test_repo_isolation_deadline_heldout.py
(which never invoke the real shim; its `>= 30` timeout assertion still holds against the 90s
watchdog). No caller relied on the old single-mode behaviour.

Also checked as asked: NO 'worker gw0 crashed' / test_editor_e2e.py signature anywhere in
the failing log -- bug 9a17 has NOT recurred. scanner-integration no longer appears.

Rebased onto current origin/main (69cd2b9e15aa). Gates on the rebased tree: make lint = 0,
make typecheck = 0 (755 files), the three uncovered gates = 54 passed, tests/unit +
tests/e2e = 15415 passed / 51 skipped. Guard self-tests run 5x consecutively and 3x under
load average 6-9: stable.

Change-Id preserved (I27290fc4ed9fe586e316780eef60d1bc8014ce6d); pushed as patchset 2.
